title: Billing invoices a confirmed sales order from its read-only view, confirms the invoice and registers a partial payment
_seedNote: an order with something to invoice (J-SALES-01 and the sales journeys confirm cable/chair orders; ordered-quantity products are to invoice on confirmation). Billing reads orders (Sales.Reader): the row opens SalesOrder_View (C1-01), not the form.

seeds.name: orderNo
seeds.sql: SELECT o.Number AS n FROM Sales.SalesOrder AS o WHERE o.InvoiceStatus = 'ToInvoice' AND o.Status = 'SalesOrder' ORDER BY o.Number DESC LIMIT 1

steps.name: Open Sales > Quotations & orders: the order is listed
Open the order: Billing gets the read-only view with Create invoice
Create invoice: the popup explains what is invoiced
Confirm the popup: a draft invoice opens
Confirm the invoice: numbered INV/, Register payment offered
Register payment: the popup proposes the amount due

outcome.label: the order's newest invoice is posted and partially paid, 10.00 less due than its total
outcome.sql: SELECT COUNT(i.ID) AS n FROM Invoicing.Invoice AS i WHERE i.ID = (SELECT MAX(x.ID) FROM Invoicing.Invoice AS x WHERE x.SourceDocument = '{{orderNo}}') AND i.Status = 'Posted' AND i.PaymentStatus = 'PartiallyPaid' AND i.AmountDue = i.AmountTotal - 10
